title: Statement of Ezhava folk physician, Itty Achudem
version: Inspected passages identified in research notes
lineage: Brief paraphrased research notes, not a reproduction.

passages.note: The National Centre for Biological Sciences identifies Itty Achudem as an Ezhava physician and attributes a signed statement in Malayalam script to him in volume 1 of Hortus Indicus Malabaricus, dated 1678.
